text.EN: They are hurt! Stay with them while I cover you.
text.TL: Nasaktan sila! Samahan mo sila habang binabantayan ko kayo.

text.EN: Our companion is down! Tend to them, I've got guard.
text.TL: Bagsak ang kasama natin! Gamutin mo, babantayan ko kayo.

text.EN: They're injured! Get them patched up while I watch.
text.TL: Sugatan sila! Bendahan mo habang nagmamasid ako.

text.EN: Check on them right now! I'll hold off the threats.
text.TL: Tignan mo sila ngayon din! Haharangin ko ang mga kalaban.

text.EN: They took a hit! See to their wounds, I'm watching.
text.TL: Tinamaan sila! Tingnan mo ang sugat nila, nakabantay ako.

text.EN: Partner is wounded! Apply first aid, I've got your back.
text.TL: Sugatan ang kasama! Maglapat ng first aid, hawak ko likod niyo.

text.EN: They're bleeding! Patch them while I keep perimeter.
text.TL: Dumurugo sila! Gamutin mo habang binabantayan ko ang paligid.

text.EN: Help them up! I'll keep the lane clear.
text.TL: Tulungan mo silang tumayo! Lilinisin ko ang daanan.

text.EN: They need attention! Administer aid, I'll protect you both.
text.TL: Kailangan nila ng lunas! Gamutin mo, poprotektahan ko kayong dalawa.

text.EN: Our friend is hurt! Help them, I'm standing sentry.
text.TL: Nasaktan ang kaibigan natin! Tulungan mo sila, nakabantay ako.
